objective:
Implement the GATED native-auth-bridge CORE for services/agents-ui per specs/021-native-auth-token-bridge/ (spec.md + tasks.md), scoped to the unit-testable client foundation. CLIENT-only; do NOT touch backend, .github/workflows/ci.yml, or src/router/** (spec 022 owns the router; this PR is additive and does NOT rewire the live guard/bootstrap yet). Web behavior MUST stay identical. Native flows are GATED (only active under Capacitor + when native origins/PKCE config are present) and the live OAuth2 AS calls are implemented as pure functions exercised with mocked fetch — no real browser handoff in this PR.

Implement under services/agents-ui/src/lib/ (and tests under src/lib/__tests__/ or src/__tests__/):

1) FROZEN AUTH/SESSION CONTRACT TYPES (e.g. src/lib/authSession/types.ts): `AuthRuntimeMode` = 'web-cookie' | 'native-bearer'; `AuthRestoreState` = 'unknown' | 'restoring' | 'authenticated' | 'anonymous'; `AuthUser` (id, username, email, role: 'ADMIN'|'USER'|'READONLY'); `AccessTokenLease` (token: string, expiresAt: number); `AuthSessionPort` (mode, restoreState, currentUser(), getAccessToken(): Promise<string|null>, restore(): Promise<void>, logout(): Promise<void>); `DeepLinkIntent` and `DeepLinkResult` (parsed OAuth callback: code, state, error). Export all from one stable module.

2) PKCE HELPERS (src/lib/authSession/pkce.ts): high-entropy code verifier (43-128 chars, unreserved charset) using crypto.getRandomValues; S256 code challenge via crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', ...) base64url-encoded; and a state generator. Pure, no backend. Provide a buildAuthorizeUrl(config, {verifier-derived challenge, state, redirectUri}) that composes the `/api/oauth2/authorize` URL (response_type=code, client_id from config, code_challenge, code_challenge_method=S256, scope, redirect_uri, state) WITHOUT a client secret.

3) DEEP-LINK CALLBACK PARSING (src/lib/authSession/deepLink.ts): parse a callback URL/intent into DeepLinkResult, validating redirect URI prefix and extracting code/state/error. Pure function; the actual Capacitor App appUrlOpen listener wiring is consumed via the 018 platform AppUrlOpener interface but NOT activated in bootstrap here.

4) SECURE-STORAGE REFRESH-TOKEN ADAPTER (src/lib/authSession/refreshTokenStore.ts): a small adapter that hides the storage plugin and exposes ONLY refresh-token record ops (read/replace/clear), backed by the 018 platform `SecureStorage` interface (resolvePlatform().secureStorage). Document that the placeholder uses the platform SecureStorage (Capacitor Preferences today) and a Keychain/Keystore-backed plugin swaps in later behind this same interface. Access tokens are kept IN MEMORY only (an AccessTokenLease holder), never persisted.

5) TOKEN EXCHANGE + REFRESH LOGIC (src/lib/authSession/tokenExchange.ts): pure async functions exchangeCode(config, {code, verifier, redirectUri}) and refresh(config, {refreshToken}) that POST to `/api/oauth2/token` via fetch (injected/global fetch) and return { accessToken, accessTokenExpiresIn, refreshToken? }. Implement SINGLE-FLIGHT refresh (concurrent callers share one in-flight exchange) and atomic rotated-refresh-token replacement through the refresh-token store. On invalid/reused/expired refresh, clear the token family and surface a re-login-required state. These are exercised with mocked fetch; real AS behavior is gated/verified later.

6) AUTH SESSION IMPLEMENTATION (src/lib/authSession/index.ts): a createAuthSession() returning an AuthSessionPort. mode = native-bearer when running under Capacitor (platformInfo.isNative) AND native auth config present, else web-cookie. WEB-COOKIE mode delegates to the existing src/lib/vueWebCommons.ts useAuth (current-user via cookie/CSRF, mapUser roles) and getAccessToken() returns null (no bearer); never touches secure storage. NATIVE-BEARER mode uses the refresh-token store + in-memory access lease + tokenExchange/refresh, getAccessToken() returns the memory lease, refreshing single-flight when near expiry. Provide a TokenProvider object (getAccessToken) suitable for the 018 CredentialsModePolicy. Do NOT replace useAuth in router/main.ts in this PR.

7) TESTS: PKCE verifier/challenge correctness (length, charset, S256 challenge matches a known vector or round-trips via subtle), state generation uniqueness; deep-link parsing (valid, state mismatch surfaced to caller, error param, wrong redirect prefix rejected); refresh-token store read/replace/clear over a stubbed SecureStorage; in-memory access lease never persisted; tokenExchange/refresh with mocked fetch including single-flight (concurrent refresh => one fetch) and rotated-token atomic replacement and reuse/expired => clear+relogin; web-cookie mode delegates to cookie path and getAccessToken()===null and never reads secure storage; native-bearer mode injects bearer via the 018 policy and omits cookies/CSRF/X-User-Id. STORAGE-HYGIENE TEST under src/__tests__/: assert that refresh tokens, access tokens, authorization codes, PKCE verifiers, and attach-tokens are NEVER written to localStorage/sessionStorage/@capacitor/preferences-directly/IndexedDB/console — by stubbing those globals and asserting no secret-valued writes during a simulated native login+refresh.

Constraints: pass `pnpm --filter @extratoast/agents-ui typecheck`, `lint` (antfu: all `import type` before value imports, external before relative within a group, function-property method signatures in interfaces, no shorthand interface methods, `new TypeError` for type-guard throws, `} catch {` brace style, `;` member delimiters, reuse `// eslint-disable-line ts/consistent-type-assertions` for needed casts), `test`, `build`. Keep the 018 static-networking guard passing (no '/api/v1' literals, X-User-Id, or window.location.host/hostname/protocol in feature code; this work is under src/lib + src/__tests__). Match existing code style.
